note: Four integers per record and nothing else: max = the far end of the line, s = where the rabbit starts, h = one hop's length (negative hops go left). LOCALE-NEUTRAL BY CONSTRUCTION - there is no authored text anywhere in this file, so it is identical in all eleven locales and needs no native panel. Build constraint, enforced by scripts/verify-number-line.js: floor((max - s) / abs(h)) >= 2, because a one-hop record makes the equality claim vacuous - a single arc cannot be the same length as anything. The first freeCount records are the FREE tier and are ALSO inlined as FALLBACK_LINES in the tool, so a 404 on this file degrades to the free tier rather than to nothing. Ordered so each record surprises after the one before. NOTE back-from-hundred is -30 and not -20 on purpose: with -20 BOTH backward records divided their line exactly, so hintWall - the string carrying the whole leftover-space thesis - was unreachable in the direction children find hardest. A native panel found that by reading the ledger against the dispatch, and verify- now asserts it.
